name: IK TECH Hausa Knowledge Base
description: Kundin ilimin Hausa domin taimaka wa IK TECH AI fahimtar Hausa da amsa tambayoyi cikin inganci.

entries.answer: Wa alaikumus salam! Barka da zuwa. Me zan taimaka maka da shi yau?
Hausa harshe ne da ake magana da shi a Najeriya, Nijar da wasu ƙasashen Afirka. Yana da tsarin nahawu, karin magana da adabin gargajiya.

questions: Waɗanne haruffa ne na musamman a Hausa?
entries.answer: Haruffan Hausa na musamman sun haɗa da ɓ, ɗ, ƙ da ƴ. Ya kamata a rubuta su yadda ya dace, kada a maye gurbinsu da b, d, k ko y idan ana nufin waɗannan haruffa.
Nahawu shi ne tsarin ƙa'idojin da ke bayyana yadda ake haɗa kalmomi domin gina jimloli masu ma'ana.
Fassara ita ce mayar da ma'anar magana ko rubutu daga wani harshe zuwa wani harshe, tare da kiyaye ainihin ma'anar saƙon.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) fasaha ce da ke ba kwamfuta damar gudanar da ayyuka kamar fahimtar harshe, nazarin bayanai, gane hotuna da taimakawa wajen warware matsaloli.
Programming ko coding shi ne rubuta umarni da kwamfuta za ta bi domin gudanar da wani aiki ko gina manhaja.

questions: Me ake karantawa a Computer Science?
entries.answer: Computer Science fanni ne da ke nazarin kwamfuta, algorithms, programming, bayanai, tsarin kwamfuta da hanyoyin warware matsaloli ta amfani da fasaha.
Kimiyya hanya ce ta bincike da lura da gwaji domin fahimtar abubuwan da ke faruwa a duniya da yadda suke aiki.

questions: Yaya ake gaishe da mutum cikin ladabi?
entries.answer: Ana iya cewa: Assalamu alaikum, barka da safiya, barka da rana, ko barka da yamma. Amsa gaisuwa cikin ladabi yana nuna mutunta juna.

questions: Yaya ake rubuta Hausa mai kyau?
entries.answer: Domin rubuta Hausa mai kyau, a kula da tsarin jimla, amfani da kalmomin da suka dace, alamomin rubutu da haruffan musamman kamar ɓ, ɗ, ƙ da ƴ.
Karin magana wata gajeriyar magana ce mai ɗauke da hikima ko darasi. Ana amfani da ita wajen bayyana wani tunani cikin salo na musamman.
